parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: The filter name. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description: The sort order of the results.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The current page number of the service group list. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of service groups to display on each page in a paged query. Settings for paging default to 100.

parameters.name: Sort
parameters.description: The field by which to sort the results.

parameters.name: TrafficMode
parameters.description: The traffic allocation method used to filter service groups.
